description: Na₃Mg(BO₂)₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.45 Å. Mg is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (2.00 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.34-1.42 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.41 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.33-1.42 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.41 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.48 Å) and two longer (1.49 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MgB tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MgB tetrahedra. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one B atom.
